container_color_scheme.info: Видимий, коли макет встановлено як «Рядок» або «Контейнер секції».

desktop_layout.label: Макет для десктопів
desktop_layout.info: Зображення завжди перше на мобільних пристроях.

separators.info: The shape takes the section background and overlaps the neighboring section: give that section enough padding. To cut into a banner, add the shape to the section next to it.
separators.color_info: Leave empty to use the section background.

animation.info: Movements stop for visitors who reduce motion.

counter.info: Put the number between braces, with any text around it: {120}K+, ${1,500} or {4.8}/5.

repeat.label: Number of fields
repeat.info: Above 1, the fields are numbered and sent to the cart as “Title 1”, “Title 2”, and so on. Use it for several photos rather than stacking blocks.

default_value.label: Default value
default_value.info: For a dropdown or choice buttons, must match one of the choices exactly.

error_message.info: Leave empty to use the theme's default message.

hide_in_cart.label: Hide from cart and order
hide_in_cart.info: The value is still recorded, it just isn't displayed to the customer.

max_length.label: Character limit
max_length.info: Always applied. 0 allows the longest text, 500 characters.

price_color.info: If price is in sale, this color applies to sale price

mobile_gutter.label: Mobile side margin
mobile_gutter.info: Keeps text away from the screen edges on mobile. Image blocks ignore it and stay edge to edge.

heading_settings.seo_info: Pick the heading tag (SEO: H1, H2…) with the Aa menu directly in the field above ↑
heading_settings.spacing_bottom_info: Space below the heading. The parent group's gap already spaces the blocks.
heading_settings.bold_info: The whole heading. When unchecked, only words bolded in the field (B button) stay bold.

bold_weight.info: Regular: only the words bolded in the field (B button) stay bold. The other weights look different only if your theme font ships them.

heading_settings.show_separator_info: The decorative line under the heading, from the theme's heading styles
heading_settings.rotating_words_info: One per line. Type [words] in the heading where they go, otherwise they follow the heading.
heading_settings.h1_info: One H1 per page: an H1 keeps its tag only in the first section of a page without a title of its own (home, page, 404). Elsewhere it becomes an H2 that looks the same.
heading_settings.subheading_spacing: Space under the subheading on desktop
heading_settings.subheading_spacing_mobile: Space under the subheading on mobile

tabs.colors_info: Leave empty to use the theme colors.

width.info: Fill stretches to share the available space, Fit content shrinks to the content's natural size, Custom uses a fixed fraction of the parent's width

align_self.label: Align self
align_self.info: Overrides the row/column's alignment for this block only, without affecting its siblings

group.padding_horizontal_info: Keeps an inner side margin, useful when the section is full width

link.label: Link
link.info: Makes the whole group clickable, like a card. The link covers the group's content; to keep several clickable areas, put links on the inner blocks instead.

background_image.label: Background image
background_image.info: The blocks placed inside this group will sit on top of this image.

background_image_mobile.label: Background image (mobile)
background_image_mobile.info: Leave blank to reuse the desktop image, repositioned using the focal point below.

min_height.label: Minimum height
min_height.info: Minimum height of the block, so the background image stays visible even when the content is short.

presets.content_over_image_text: Pair text with an image to focus on your chosen product, collection, or promotion.

transparent_background.label: Transparent background
transparent_background.info: Lets the section behind show through instead of applying a palette.

full_bleed_mobile.label: Edge to edge on mobile
full_bleed_mobile.info: On mobile only: the image escapes the section's side gutter. Disable to keep the image inside the margin (card look).

add_margins.label: Add margins
add_margins.info: Space around the image, adjustable per screen size

link_title.label: Link accessibility label
link_title.info: Announced by screen readers when the image has no alt text set in Files. Leave blank if the image already has descriptive alt text.

text_items.label: Text (one phrase per line)
text_items.info: One phrase per line. Blank lines are ignored.

marquee.images_info: Add one image per child block. They scroll in the order you arrange them.

full_bleed.label: Edge to edge
full_bleed.info: Escapes the group or section's side padding on every screen size. Only applies when width is set to "Fill available space".

text_item.info: This field accepts a dynamic source, so a metafield.

marquee.text_blocks_info: To bind a metafield to a phrase, add a Phrase block below instead of typing in the field above.

mode.info: Automatic follows the payment methods enabled in Settings > Payments. Use custom images for badges Shopify doesn't expose (e.g. "Buy now, pay later" providers).

payment_icons.images_info: Add the badge images to show, in order.

types.label: Payment methods
types.info: Separated by commas, in display order, for example visa, master, american_express, paypal, apple_pay, google_pay, shopify_pay, klarna.

pictogram.sizing_info: This pictogram is a decorative overlay positioned by Top/Left above, not by its place in the layout. Width and alignment below only reserve its (invisible) slot among the other blocks: they don't change its size or position on screen.

empty_color.label: Empty stars colour
empty_color.info: Tints the unfilled stars. Leave empty to use a muted grey. The filled stars always keep Trustpilot's own green.

link.info: Optional link to your Trustpilot profile

image_before_after.after_info: Use the same framing as the Before image: with Adapt to image, the frame takes the shape of the Before image and the After image is cropped to fit.

customize_colors.label: Customize colors
customize_colors.info: Left off, the handle follows the theme's default style.

custom_url.label: URL to share
custom_url.info: Leave blank to share the current page

share.social_info: Links come from Theme settings > Social media. A network left blank is not shown.

size.label: Spacing
size.info: Room the block takes up, the line centred inside: its height, or its width when vertical.

spacer.line_color_info: Leave empty to use the text color at 15% opacity

icon.color_info: Leave empty to inherit the text color

custom_liquid.label: Liquid code
custom_liquid.info: Add app snippets or other Liquid code to create advanced customizations

video.video_url_info: Used only when no Shopify video is selected above
video.cover_image_info: Leave empty to use the video's own preview image

rating.stars_style_info: Star colors are set globally in Theme settings > Stars
rating.color_info: Leave empty to follow the theme's global stars style

text_color.info: Leave blank to follow the stars text color set in the theme settings.

accordion.content_default: Orders are dispatched within 24 hours and delivered in 2 to 4 working days. You get a tracking link as soon as the parcel leaves our warehouse.

page.label: Page
page.info: Adds the page content below the content above

open_by_default.label: Open by default
open_by_default.info: If "Close other accordions when this one opens" is on for several accordions in the section, only enable this on one of them: otherwise the browser only keeps the last one open.

exclusive.label: Close other accordions when this one opens
exclusive.info: Groups this accordion with every other accordion in the same section that also has this enabled: opening one closes the rest, like a FAQ. Handled by the browser, without JavaScript: older browsers simply keep several panels open at once.

accordion.background_color_info: Leave empty to use the secondary background color
accordion.border_color_info: Leave empty to use the text color at 12% opacity

checklist.align_icon_top: Align the icon with the first line
checklist.align_icon_top_info: Useful when an item runs over several lines
checklist.icon_color_info: Leave empty to use the accent color
checklist.items_legacy_info: Legacy field, kept for lists already in place. Fill the field above to move to rich text.

testimonial.text_default: I've been using this product for a few weeks now and the difference is real. Shipping was fast and the packaging was lovely.

role.label: Role
role.info: Shown under the name, for example "Verified buyer"

countdown.accent_color_info: Leave empty to use the secondary text color

badge.text_color_info: Leave empty to use the background color

button.width_info: Fill the available space makes the button full width. Fit to content shrinks it to its natural size, Custom gives it a fixed fraction of the parent width.
button.text_info: Accepts bold, italic and a dynamic source.

seo.rating_label: Add the rating to search results
seo.rating_info: Adds the rating and review count your reviews app saves on the product. Most reviews apps add their own review markup: turn this on only if yours does not, or Google sees the rating twice.

cart_drawer.name: Cart drawer

open_on_add.info: Otherwise only the cart count in the header updates.
open_on_add.label: Open after adding a product

preview_empty.info: Only in the theme editor, to design the empty state.
preview_empty.label: Preview empty cart

radius.info: Used by the floating style and the mobile bottom sheet.

cart_drawer.swipe_to_close: Swipe to close on touch screens

preview_drawer.label: Preview drawer in customizer
preview_drawer.info: Keep the cart drawer open while designing in the theme editor

auto_close.info: 0 keeps it open until the customer closes it.
auto_close.label: Close after

main_cart.mobile_summary_first: Show the summary first on mobile

announcement_bar.name: Announcement bar

sticky.info: Like the header: always visible, or visible when scrolling up. A sticky header stays under it.

announcement_bar.dismissible_info: Shoppers can hide the bar for the rest of their visit. A changed message shows it again.

hero.image_info: Also covers a video while it loads. The focal point set on the image keeps the subject in frame on every screen.
hero.mobile_optional: Optional: the desktop media is used when empty.
hero.video_button: Show a pause button on videos
hero.link_info: Makes the whole banner clickable. Buttons and links inside keep their own link.

height.label: Height
height.info: Full screen takes the header and the announcement bar into account.

hero.padding_mobile: Space around the content on mobile

page_width.label: Keep the content within the page width
page_width.info: On wide screens, the content lines up with the rest of the page instead of the edges of the media.

structured_data.label: Mark up the questions for search engines
structured_data.info: Adds FAQ structured data to the accordions of this section. Keep it on for a single FAQ section per page.

scroll_cards.name: Stacking cards
scroll_cards.shrink: Shrink and darken the card underneath
scroll_cards.info: Cards stick one after another. Keep each card shorter than the screen, so its content shows in full before the next card covers it.

scroll_horizontal.name: Horizontal scroll
scroll_horizontal.intro_info: The first blocks stay above the cards. On desktop, the cards move sideways while the page scrolls; on mobile, they swipe.

scroll_zoom.length_info: How far the page scrolls while the media grows, in % of the screen height.

floating_video.name: Floating video
floating_video.urls_info: One per line, such as /pages/about. End with * to include every address that starts with it.
floating_video.editor_info: In the editor, the video shows only while this section is selected. Shoppers can minimize or close it for their visit.

featured_product.name: Featured product
featured_product.product_info: The blocks of the section show this product. Empty: the section stays hidden on your store.

quick_order.name: Quick order list
quick_order.intro: Lists variants with a quantity for each, added to the cart in one go. Quantity rules and B2B volume pricing apply.
quick_order.product_info: Leave empty on a product page to list its variants.
quick_order.collection_info: Used with the collection source: each product of the page lists its variants.
quick_order.heading: Quick order
quick_order.text: Choose a quantity for each size and colour, then add everything to your cart at once.

landing_mode.name: Landing page mode
landing_mode.info: Hides the chosen parts on every page using this template, for visitors coming from ads. Place this section at the bottom of the page: it shows nothing to shoppers.

hide_floating.label: Hide floating elements
hide_floating.info: Floating video, floating back to top button and the popups of the footer. Popups added to this template still show.

quick_view.name: Quick view
quick_view.info: This template fills the quick view that product cards open. Add, remove and arrange the product blocks here: the sticky add to cart bar never shows in it.
quick_view.window_info: Applies to the quick view opened from product cards. In a side panel, the blocks stack like on a phone.

width.info: How the block uses the space its container gives it.

align_self.info: Overrides the alignment set on the container.

width_mobile.label: Mobile width
width_mobile.info: A fraction of twelve rarely makes sense on one column. Leave on Inherit to keep the desktop setting.

show_from_price.label: Show "from" price
show_from_price.info: For products whose variants have different prices.

offers_follow.label: Price shown with an offer
offers_follow.info: Follows the Offers, Purchase options and Add-ons blocks of this product.

show_installments.label: Show Shop Pay Installments
show_installments.info: Shown when Shop Pay Installments is on in your payment settings and the price is eligible.

show_tax_note.label: Show the tax and shipping note
show_tax_note.info: Says whether taxes are included and that shipping is calculated at checkout, with a link to your shipping policy when you have one.

product_context.info: Left empty, the block uses the closest product: its container, its section, or the page.

heading_level.info: Use h1 once per page, on the main product.

product_rating.name: Product rating
product_rating.source_info: Product reads the rating and the number of reviews your review app saves on the product. Without reviews, the block stays hidden on the store and shows a sample in the editor.
product_rating.info: One line with the product's stars and review count, near its title. For the breakdown by stars, use Rating summary. For a score you type outside the product, use Stars (typed score).

preshot.label: Preload the first image
preshot.info: Shows a sliver of the next media so visitors know they can swipe.

exclude_variant_images.label: Hide variant images
exclude_variant_images.info: Images attached to a variant stay out of the gallery and show on selection.

layout_mobile.info: A different layout per screen is rendered twice; keep the carousel on mobile unless the media are few.

mosaic_pattern.label: Pattern
mosaic_pattern.info: Which media get the full row.

fit.label: Fill mode
fit.info: Cover crops to the ratio, Contain shows the whole image.

full_bleed.info: The media escape the page margins.

sticky.info: On desktop, the gallery stays in place while the rest of the section scrolls past it.

featured_count.label: Large images at the start
featured_count.info: They take the full width above the grid, in the ratio set below.

product_variants.name: Variant picker

size_guide_trigger.label: Option that carries it
size_guide_trigger.info: The exact name of the option, for example Size.

show_selected_value.label: Show the selected value beside the option name

swatches.label: Show colour options as swatches
swatches.info: Uses the colour or image saved on each option value in Shopify, otherwise the value's name when it is a colour (Black, Navy, Beige).

swatch_option_names.label: Options shown as swatches
swatch_option_names.info: Option names, separated by commas. Options with swatches saved in Shopify are always included.

size_guide_page.label: Page shown in the guide
size_guide_page.info: The only way to show a real size table: build it in the page, the guide displays its content.

product_variants.offers_info: Turns an option value into an offer card, in the List and Buttons types. Type the value exactly as it is in Shopify, for example 2+1 FREE.

offer_title.info: Left empty, the option value is shown.

product_variants.offer_cards_when: These cards only restyle an option value: the variant is charged at its own price. To show the saving against single items, or to add quantity breaks and gifts, use the Offers block (Packs preset) instead.

show_cart_qty.label: Show the quantity already in the cart

cart_qty.label: Cart quantity text
cart_qty.info: $qty stands for the quantity. Leave empty for the default text in the language of the store.

volume_pricing.label: Show volume pricing
volume_pricing.info: For B2B customers, when their catalog gives the product quantity price breaks.

button_text.info: Leave empty for "Add to cart" in the language of the store. [price], [compare_price], [savings] and [percent] follow the selected offer.

show_qty.label: Show a quantity selector
show_qty.info: Leave off when a separate Quantity block is used, or the form gets two fields.

extra_button.label: Show payment icons and a rating under the buttons

button_subtext.label: Second line
button_subtext.info: Shown under the button text, inside the button. [price], [compare_price], [savings] and [percent] follow the selected offer.

gift_card_recipient.label: Let shoppers send a gift card to someone
gift_card_recipient.info: Gift card products only: the shopper can enter the email, name, message and send date of the recipient.

extra.image_info: Shown instead of the payment icons.

preorder.label: Show pre-order
preorder.info: Out of stock but still sold: a tracked variant with no stock that Shopify keeps selling (Continue selling when out of stock). The order line then carries a Pre-order property.

options.sold_out: Out of stock but still sold

preorder_message.label: Message under the button
preorder_message.info: For example: Ships from 15 October. Also saved on the order line.

back_in_stock.label: Notify me form
back_in_stock.info: Shown under the button while the selected variant is sold out. Email sends the store a contact message with the product, variant and SKU. Klaviyo needs its public API key in Theme settings, General.

back_in_stock_text.label: Text above the form
back_in_stock_text.placeholder: Get an email as soon as this option is back in stock.

show_wishlist.label: Show the wishlist button
show_wishlist.info: Heart beside the add to cart button, when the wishlist is on in theme settings. Turn it off to place the Wishlist button block wherever you like.

checkout_type.label: Second button
checkout_type.info: Express checkout shows the shopper's wallets, with Shopify's own text. Buy now adds the selection to the cart and opens the checkout, with your text.

sticky.info: On desktop, the group stays in place while the rest of the section scrolls past it.

attribute_name.info: Shown on the order in your admin, for example Gift wrap.
attribute_name.label: Attribute name

default_on.info: Adds the product once per visit when the cart has other items. In the EU, pre-ticked paid options are not allowed: keep this off for paid add-ons.
default_on.label: Pre-selected

mode.info: Product: adds a real line, for example shipping protection. Cart attribute: saves a yes or no on the order, for example gift wrap.
mode.label: Type

product.info: Use a single-variant product, hidden from your collections if needed.

show_accelerated.info: Shop Pay, Apple Pay, Google Pay or PayPal, when enabled in your payment settings.
show_accelerated.label: Show express checkout

button_subtext.label: Second line
button_subtext.info: A short text under the label, for example Secure payment.

cart_common.default_text_info: Leave empty to use the translated default.

visibility.label: Show this block
visibility.info: Every filled condition must be met.

options.show: Only when the conditions are met
options.hide: Except when the conditions are met

visibility.amount_info: In your store currency. Empty: no condition.

tags.label: Customer tags
tags.info: Separated by commas. Customers with at least one of them.

countries.label: Countries
countries.info: Country codes separated by commas, for example FR, BE, CH.

markets.label: Markets
markets.info: Market handles separated by commas, as shown in Settings > Markets.

visibility.products: Cart contains one of these products
visibility.collections: Cart contains a product from these collections
visibility.handles_info: Handles separated by commas, as shown at the end of the address, for example blue-shirt.

design.colors_info: Empty: the colors of the cart.

full_width.label: Full width
full_width.info: Goes edge to edge, over the side spacing of its zone.

flush.label: Stick to the edge of the zone
flush.info: Removes the space to the edge of its zone (as first or last block) and to a full-width block next to it.

icon_image.label: Custom icon
icon_image.info: A square SVG or PNG works best.

allow_plan_change.info: Shows a purchase option selector on products sold by subscription.
allow_plan_change.label: Let customers change their subscription

gift_label.info: Shown on gift lines. Leave empty for the default text.
gift_label.label: Gift badge

hide_addons.info: The product added by a Checkbox product block stays managed by its own control.
hide_addons.label: Hide checkbox products from the list

low_stock_threshold.info: Shows "Only X left" below this quantity, for tracked inventory. 0 turns it off.
low_stock_threshold.label: Low stock alert

show_headings.info: Only on wide layouts such as the cart page.
show_headings.label: Show column headings

undo_text.label: Undo message
undo_text.info: Use [title] for the product name. Leave empty for the default text.

unit_price_label.label: Text after the price per item

savings_badge_text.info: Use [percent] or [amount]. Leave empty for the default text.

collection.info: Only products from this collection count towards the goal. Leave empty to count the whole cart.
collection.label: Count only one collection

gift.info: With several products, the first available one is added and customers can switch to another. The price becomes zero only with an automatic discount in Shopify.

gift_mode.info: Gifts are added automatically once their tier is reached and taken back out below it. A gift the customer removes is not added again during the visit.

cart_rewards.intro: Motivate customers with up to three rewards. Discounts and free shipping are created in Shopify: this block shows the progress towards them.

market_thresholds.info: Optional. Tier thresholds for other currencies, for example USD:60,120;GBP:50,100. Otherwise they are converted at the exchange rate.
market_thresholds.label: Thresholds per currency

message_progress.info: Use [amount] for what is left and [reward] for the next reward.
message_progress.label: Progress message

cart_rewards.name: Rewards progress

threshold.info: An amount in your store currency, or a number of items.
threshold.label: Threshold

cart_rewards.hide_when_complete: Hide the bar once every tier is reached

cart_savings.name: Savings banner

text.info: Use [amount] for the amount saved and [percent] for the percentage.

cart_savings.min_savings_info: Savings needed before the banner shows, in the store currency.

remember.info: Keeps the box ticked for the rest of the visit.
remember.label: Remember the choice

cart_timer.intro: The countdown never empties the cart: when it ends, the items stay where they are.
cart_timer.name: Reservation timer
cart_timer.restart_on_add: Restart when a product is added

text.info: Use [time] for the countdown. Leave empty for the default.

collection.info: With Shopify recommendations, shown when Shopify has nothing to suggest.

cart_upsells.hide_in_cart: Hide products already in the cart

intent.info: Complementary products are set in the Search & Discovery app; related products are generated by Shopify.
intent.label: Recommendation type

cart_upsells.name: Upsells

source.info: Recommendations are based on the products in the cart.
source.label: Source

metafield.label: Metafield
metafield.info: A product list metafield, as namespace.key. The block gathers the products set on every product of the cart.

autoplay.label: Auto-scroll every
autoplay.info: 0 turns it off. It pauses while the shopper points at or uses the carousel.

cards_visible_wide.label: Visible cards on wide spaces
cards_visible_wide.info: From 720 px wide, as on the cart page on a computer. The drawer and phones use the setting above.

card_layout.label: Card layout
card_layout.info: With the image on the left, about 1.2 visible cards leaves room for the text.

sticky_footer.info: Keeps the total and the checkout button in view while the items scroll.
sticky_footer.label: Keep at the bottom

show_close.label: Show close button
show_close.info: Hidden, it stays reachable with the keyboard. Escape and a click outside also close the drawer.

cart_zone.hide_blocks_when_empty: Hide these blocks when the cart is empty

show_wishlist_link.label: Link to the wishlist
show_wishlist_link.info: Shows when the wishlist is on in the theme settings, with its page link.

cart_attribute.name: Order field
cart_attribute.intro: Asks for a piece of information saved on the order under its own name: a dropdown, a date, a checkbox or a text, required or not. The order note, by contrast, is a single free text.
cart_attribute.label_info: Leave empty to use the attribute name.
cart_attribute.min_days: Earliest date, in days from today
cart_attribute.max_days: Latest date, in days from today

required.label: Required
required.info: Checkout stays blocked until the field is filled in or ticked.

attribute_name.default: How did you hear about us?

cart_shipping.name: Shipping estimate
cart_shipping.intro: Customers pick a country, a region and a postal code to see the shipping rates of your store.

options.inline: Postal code and button on one line

hide_when_empty.discounts: Only show when there is a discount
hide_when_empty.savings: Only show when there are savings

show_compare.label: Show the price before discounts, crossed out
show_compare.info: Shown when compare at prices or discounts lower the amount. The subtotal includes the discounts on items, the total also the codes on the whole order.

cart_urgency.name: Urgency message
cart_urgency.intro: Shows a message using Shopify stock, a product metafield or an animated number.

text.default: High demand: items in your cart are selling fast

options.untracked: The cart holds a product with untracked stock
options.count: A product has a number in its metafield

text_low.info: [quantity] is the real stock of the item closest to selling out, [product] its name.

text_count.info: [count] is the number in the metafield, [product] the product's name.

metafield.label: Product metafield
metafield.info: Namespace and key of an integer metafield, for example custom.recent_sales, that Shopify Flow or an app keeps up to date.

cart_urgency.number_info: Add [nbr] to the text. The number randomly changes by 1 while staying between these limits.

cart_countdown.name: Cart countdown
cart_countdown.intro: Counts down to a real deadline: the end of an offer, or today's order cut-off time.
cart_countdown.time_info: Format HH:MM, in the store's time zone.

cutoff.label: Cut-off time
cutoff.info: Format HH:MM, in the store's time zone. Past that time, the countdown hides until the next day.

offer.name: Offer
offer.subtitle: Subtitle

discount_value.label: Value
discount_value.info: A number: a percentage, or an amount in your store currency. It can be connected to a product metafield.

free_quantity.label: Free items
free_quantity.info: Buy X, get Y: added on top of the quantity.

option_value.label: Linked option value
option_value.info: Sells the variant with this option value, for example Pack of 3. Leave empty to sell the quantity.

products.label: Products
products.info: Added with the offer. It can be connected to a product list metafield.

gifts.label: Gift products
gifts.info: Added as gifts under the product line, and removed with it.

offer.checkout_info: The theme shows the price, Shopify charges it. Create the matching automatic discount in Discounts: Amount off products with a minimum quantity, or Buy X get Y for free items and gifts. In the editor, a warning appears when the discount is missing after an add to cart.

discount_code.info: Applied to the cart when this offer is added. Leave empty when an automatic discount applies.

offer.highlight_info: Outlines the card in the accent color with a line along its top, which stays when the offer is selected. Add a badge to say why.
offer.selected_info: Checked when the page opens. A ?variant= in the address wins over it.

product_offers.info: Quantity breaks, bundles, Buy X get Y and gifts. Each Offer block is one choice.

details.label: Offer details
details.info: Options per item, products included, gifts and blocks added to an offer.

product_offers.colors_info: Empty colors follow the color scheme.

quantity_sync.label: Sync the quantity selector
quantity_sync.info: Needs a quantity selector on the page. On: the quantity follows the selected offer, and a quantity typed by the shopper selects the matching offer. Off: the offer sets the quantity, and the quantity selector is hidden while an offer is selected.

mark_lines.label: Name the offer on cart lines
mark_lines.info: Hidden from the cart and checkout, shown in your orders in the Shopify admin. Off, the editor no longer warns when an offer reaches the cart without its discount.

product_offers.show_variants_info: Shoppers pick the size or colour of each item in the offer, included products and gifts too. Off: the items follow the variant chosen on the page, included products and gifts take their first available variant. A product with more than 250 variants always works as when this is off.
product_offers.packs_when: Packs sold as a variant (an option such as 1, 2 or 3 jars) show their saving against single items here. To only restyle option values as cards, use the Offer cards of the Variant picker block.

gift_style.label: Gift style
gift_style.info: Banner: along the bottom of the card, filled with the selected colors once its offer is chosen. Line: a line inside the card.

gift_display.label: Show gifts on
gift_display.info: Lists only: grid, carousel and compact show gifts under the selected offer. A gift's variant selector only shows on the selected offer.

gift_tag.label: Label style
gift_tag.info: The label's wording is set on each offer.

color_gift_idle_bg.label: Gift background
color_gift_idle_bg.info: Banner: on the offers not selected.

color_gift_price.label: Gift price
color_gift_price.info: On a filled banner, the price takes the text color.

product_subscription.name: Purchase options
product_subscription.info: One-time purchase or subscription, from the selling plans of your subscription app. Blocks added here show under the subscription.

default.info: Shopify recommends one-time purchase. A product sold only by subscription always starts on it.

plan_picker.label: Frequency picker
plan_picker.info: Five frequencies or more always show as a dropdown.

subscription_label.label: Subscription label
subscription_label.info: Empty: the name of the selling plan group, or the translated default.

badge_text.info: [percent] and [amount] are replaced by the saving. Empty: the translated default.

checked.label: Selected by default
checked.info: Leave paid add-ons unselected: the shopper chooses them.

attach.label: Remove it with the product
attach.info: Nested under the product line in the cart, and removed with it.

discount.label: Discount shown
discount.info: Shopify charges it only with a matching automatic discount: Amount off products, on this product. Not Buy X get Y, which does not add up with a Buy X get Y offer on the main product. 100% shows the add-on as free.

product_addons.name: Add-ons
product_addons.info: Gift wrapping, protection, accessories, a gift to choose or products bought together. Each Add-on block is one product.

mode.label: Add to cart
mode.info: With a separate button, the block adds the product and the selected add-ons on its own.

product_addons.button_label_info: [count] and [price] are replaced by the number of items and the total.
product_addons.show_variants_info: Shoppers pick the size or colour of each add-on. An add-on with more than 250 variants takes its first available variant.

discount_scope.label: Discount applies to
discount_scope.info: The product and its add-ons: create the matching automatic discount on the product too.

menu.name: Menu
menu.heading_info: Leave empty to use the menu title.

social.info: Add your profile links in Theme settings > Social media.

follow_on_shop.label: Show Follow on Shop
follow_on_shop.info: Lets customers follow your store in the Shop app. Requires Shop Pay.

logo.name: Logo
logo.image_info: Leave empty to use the logo from Settings > Brand, or your store name.

image_dark.label: Logo for dark backgrounds
image_dark.info: Shown automatically when the section background is dark.

wordmark.name: Wordmark
wordmark.text_info: Leave empty to use your store name. The text always fills the full width.

crop.label: Crop the bottom
crop.info: Hides the bottom of the letters, as if they went past the edge of the page.

copyright.name: Copyright
copyright.text_info: [year] shows the current year and [store] your store name, linked to the home page.

menu.label: Additional links
menu.info: For example a legal notice, an accessibility statement or an order withdrawal page.

cookies.label: Show a cookie preferences link
cookies.info: Opens the preferences of the Shopify cookie banner. Only shown where the banner is active.

status.label: Show open or closed now
status.info: Worked out live in your store time zone from the hours below.

hours.format: For example 09:00-18:00, or 09:00-12:30, 14:00-19:00. Leave empty when closed.

info.email: Leave empty to use your store email.
info.phone: Leave empty to use your store phone number.
info.address: Leave empty to use your store address.
info.whatsapp: Your number with the country code, for example +33 6 12 34 56 78.

floating.label: Floating button
floating.info: Stays in a corner of the screen on every page and appears once the customer scrolls down.

localization.name: Country and language
localization.info: Selectors appear when your store sells in several countries or languages. Set them up in Settings > Markets and Languages.

currency.label: Show currency
currency.info: Only when your countries use different currencies.

newsletter.tags_info: Added to the customer profile, separated by commas.

code.label: Discount code to reveal
code.info: Shown with a copy button once the customer has subscribed. Create the code in Discounts.

sms.label: Collect phone numbers for SMS
sms.info: Adds an optional phone field. The SMS consent box becomes required once a number is typed, and the tag below is added to the customer.

reveal.label: Reveal effect on scroll
reveal.info: On desktop, the page slides up to uncover the footer. Only when the footer fits in the window.

image.label: Badge image
image.info: A logo or certification, for example B Corp or organic. Replaces the icon.

header_announcements.name: Announcements
header_announcements.arrows_info: Always shown when rotation is off.
header_announcements.follow_info: 0 follows the bar or the header.

show_pause.label: Show the pause button
show_pause.info: Recommended for accessibility whenever messages move on their own.

header_announcement.name: Message
header_announcement.link_info: The whole message becomes the link.

countdown_end.label: Countdown end
countdown_end.info: Format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, in the store's time zone. Leave empty for no countdown.

expired_text.label: Text once ended
expired_text.info: Empty: the message hides when the countdown ends.

header_drawer.name: Menu drawer

pin.label: Pin the blocks under the menu to the bottom
pin.info: Account, languages and social links, for example.

header_drawer.logo_info: Empty: the logo from your brand settings.

header_drawer_menu.name: Drawer menu
header_drawer_menu.tab_label_info: When two menus or more have a label, the drawer shows them as tabs.
header_drawer_menu.open_current: Open the branch of the current page

link_images.label: Link images
link_images.info: The collection or product image of each link.

header_drawer_menu.mega_content: Show the mega menu content in submenus

hide_on_scroll.label: Fold away when the page scrolls
hide_on_scroll.info: With a sticky header, the row hides once the page scrolls and comes back at the top.

logo_transparent.label: Logo over the first section
logo_transparent.info: Shown while the header is transparent, at the same width.

header_logo.text_size_info: Size of the store name when there is no logo.

header_account.name: Account
header_account.show_name: Greet logged-in customers by their first name

style.label: Opens
style.info: The sign-in window needs the new customer accounts (Settings > Customer accounts).

header_wishlist.name: Wishlist
header_wishlist.info: Shown when the wishlist is turned on in Theme settings.

header_socials.info: Links come from Theme settings > Social media.

source.info: Markets: the countries and languages set up in Shopify. Other stores: links to your other storefronts, one store block each.

layout.info: Dropdown for the header bar, rows for the menu drawer. Hidden on the store when there is only one country and one language.

header_localization.show_language_info: Shown on your store once a second language is published (Settings > Languages). The editor previews it.

header_store.name: Store
header_store.url_info: Full address, such as https://example.com. The store whose domain matches the visited address is shown as selected.

header_menu.submenu_style_info: Mega menu opens a full-width panel for every link that has sublinks. Add a Mega menu panel block to design the panel of one link yourself.
header_menu.highlight_last: Show the last link as a button

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.info: Below 990px, the top-level links scroll sideways on one line.

options.view_all: Opens its submenu, with a View all link
options.split: Its title goes to its page, the arrow opens

line.width_info: Share of the link's width, centered.

links_overflow.label: Links that don't fit
links_overflow.info: Under More, a link only keeps its sub-links: no mega panel and no third level. On a new line, every link keeps its panel.

menu_item.label: Link to open
menu_item.info: A top-level link of the menu: its title, its address starting with / or its position, for example Shop, /collections/all or 1.

height.label: Panel height
height.info: 0 follows the content. With a height, only blocks whose Image ratio is “Fill the height” stretch to it; the others leave empty space below.

header_mega_products.collection_info: Used when no product is chosen.
header_mega_products.secondary_image: Show the second image on hover
header_mega_products.name: Featured products

header_search.name: Search

animated_placeholder.label: Rotating placeholder
animated_placeholder.info: One phrase per line, typed one after another while the field is empty.

popular.label: Popular searches
popular.info: One per line. Also suggested when a search finds nothing.

header_search.shortcut: Open with the / key on desktop

product_list.name: Product list
product_list.collection_info: Empty: the collection of the page on collection pages, all products elsewhere.
product_list.product_info: Empty: the product of the page. Recommendations and recently viewed products hide their section when there is nothing to show.
product_list.hide_current: Hide the product of the page
product_list.empty_text: Text when there is nothing to show
product_list.empty_text_info: For recommendations, recently viewed and wishlist products. Empty: the section hides itself.

product_card.info: The card is shared by every product of the list: its blocks show the details of each product.

card_media.gallery: Browse the images in the card
card_media.video: Play the product video on hover
card_media.badges_info: Discount and sold out badges, and product tags starting with badge- (badge-new shows "New"). Text and style come from the theme settings.
card_media.quick_add_info: A button over the image; products with options open their choices in the card. For a button with the variant picker under the image, add the Add to cart block to the card.

quick_view.label: Quick view button
quick_view.info: Opens the product in a window, filled by the Quick view product template.

card_swatches.name: Swatches
card_swatches.option_info: Option name, for example Color or Size. Empty: the first option with swatches or a colour name.
card_swatches.preview: Show the variant image on hover

card_inventory.info: Uses the stock tracked by Shopify. Products that are not tracked show nothing.

page_content.name: Page content
page_content.page_info: Leave empty to show the content of the page being viewed.

product_collection.label: Add a collection on product pages
product_collection.info: The collection the customer came from, otherwise the first collection of the product.

order_tracking.name: Order tracking

carriers.label: Carriers to list
carriers.info: Names separated by commas, for example: Colissimo, Mondial Relay, UPS. Leave empty to list every carrier.

order_tracking.order_tab: Show a Find my order tab
order_tracking.orders: List the recent orders of logged-in customers
order_tracking.service: Results come from 17TRACK, loaded only when a customer searches. A link can fill in the number: add ?tracking= followed by the number to the address of the page.

faq_schema.label: Include in the FAQ structured data
faq_schema.info: Applies in an FAQ section whose question markup is on.

map.name: Map
map.load_on_scroll_info: Otherwise the map loads when the shopper asks for it: the page stays fast and nothing is sent to Google before.
map.cover_info: Shown until the map loads. Without an image, an illustrated map in your colors is shown.
map.show_address: Show the address on the map

video.autoplay_info: Starts without sound once the video is on screen.
video.ratio_info: Fill the height follows the row the video sits in. A height in % of the screen suits a sticky column.
video.content_info: Blocks added inside the video show over it.

text_reveal.name: Text reveal
text_reveal.color_info: Leave empty to follow the color scheme.

comparison.name: Comparison table
comparison.tooltips: Show info texts in a tooltip
comparison.name_info: Empty on the highlighted column: your store name.
comparison.product_info: Fills in the name, the image, the price and the button link.
comparison.values_info: One setting group per column, in their order.

contact_form.name: Contact form
contact_form.label_info: Also names the answer in the email you receive.
contact_form.subject: Subject
contact_form.subject_info: One per line. Leave empty to let customers type it.
contact_form.callback: I would like to be called back

collection_card.name: Collection card
collection_card.info: The card is shared by every collection of the list: its blocks show the details of each collection.
collection_card.image_info: Empty: the collection image, then the image of its first product. Connect a collection metafield to pick another image for each collection.
collection_card.text_info: Empty: the collection description. Connect a collection metafield for a text of your own.

collection_list.name: Collection list
collection_list.collections_info: Empty: the collections of your store, in alphabetical order.
collection_list.menu_info: The collections linked in the menu and in its submenus, in the order of the menu.
collection_list.limit_info: Per page when the pagination shows.

calculator.name: Savings calculator
calculator.cost_per_use: Cost per use of a durable product
calculator.compare_info: For a product bought again and again. The shopper picks how many they use per day, week or month. Example: your coffee costs 0.35 a cup, 3.50 at a café. At 10 cups a week, the shopper saves 136.50 a month.
calculator.subscription_info: The shopper picks how often a delivery arrives. Example: 30 as a one-time purchase, 24 with the subscription. Delivered every 4 weeks, the shopper saves 6 per delivery, 78 a year.
calculator.cost_per_use_info: For a product that replaces a recurring expense. The shopper picks how often they use it. Example: a 60 razor lasts 200 shaves, so 0.30 per shave, against 1.00 for a disposable one. At 5 shaves a week, the shopper saves 182 a year.
calculator.price_info: In your store currency, for example 12.50. Converted for shoppers who pay in another currency.
calculator.use_compare: Use its compare-at price as the other price
calculator.question: Question
calculator.tokens: Codes in brackets are replaced as the slider moves. [monthly_savings] and [yearly_savings]: saved per month and per year. [unit_savings]: saved per unit, delivery or use. [percent]: percentage saved, without the % sign. [our_price] and [their_price]: the two prices. [our_cost] and [their_cost]: cost per month of each option. [cost_per_use]: your price per use. [quantity] and [unit]: the slider value.
calculator.chart: Show the cost per month of each option
calculator.intro: Shoppers move a slider and see what they save with your product. Choose what to compare, fill in the two prices, then write the question and the result.
calculator.product_info: Only read when prices come from a product. Leave empty on a product page to use the product of the page.
calculator.compare_product: Your price is the product price. The other price is its compare-at price when the box below is ticked and the product has one, otherwise the price typed below.
calculator.subscription_product: The one-time price is the product price. The subscription price comes from its first subscription plan, or from the price typed below when it has none.
calculator.cost_per_use_product: The price of your product is the product price. Fill in how many uses it lasts and the cost per use of the alternative.
calculator.use_price: Cost per use of the alternative
calculator.unit_info: Plural, shown after the number: 10 coffees per week.
calculator.period_info: Shown after the value: per week, or every 4 weeks for a subscription.
calculator.label_info: Shown next to its bar. Leave empty for a name that fits the calculation.
calculator.button_link_info: Leave empty to link to the product when prices come from a product.

blog.blog_info: Empty: the blog of the page, otherwise the blog with the handle news. On the blog page, its articles are split into pages.
blog.hide_current: Hide the article of the page
blog.hide_current_info: On an article page, the articles that share its tags come first.
blog.paging: Page navigation on the blog page
blog.card_info: The card is shared by every article of the list: its blocks show the details of each article.
blog.copy: Copy link, or share menu on phones
blog.author_info: Empty: taken from the staff account that published the article.

account.info: For classic customer accounts. With new customer accounts, Shopify shows its own account pages.

review_summary.name: Rating summary
review_summary.info: Reviews come from your review app. Product reads the rating and the number of reviews that apps save on the product.
review_summary.distribution_info: Percentages from 5 to 1 star, separated by commas, for example 82, 12, 4, 1, 1.
review_summary.text_info: [count] shows the number of reviews. Empty: Based on [count] reviews.
review_summary.when: A detailed block: average, review count and the breakdown by stars, for a reviews section. For one line near the product title, use Product rating.

stories.duration_info: Time per image. Videos play to the end.

ugc.style_info: Instagram: a profile grid. Each post opens in a window with its caption, comments and product.
ugc.post_type_info: The icon in the corner of the post. Automatic: Reel for a video, otherwise Photo.
ugc.date_info: For example 4d. Shown in the post window.
ugc.comments_list_info: One per line: name: comment (likes), for example ines.b: Love it (12). Likes are optional.
ugc.carousel_info: Slides after the first image, shown in the post window.
ugc.author_info: Shown in the classic style. In the Instagram style, the post window shows the profile's name.

testimonial.font_info: Applies to the text blocks inside.

before_after.hint: Move the handle when it comes into view

popup.editor_info: In the editor, the popup opens while this section or one of its blocks is selected.
popup.auto_open_info: Once the delay has passed and the page is scrolled far enough. Links ending with #popup- and the popup name always open it.
popup.exit_intent: Also open when the pointer leaves the page (desktop)
popup.name: Popup name
popup.name_info: Used by links such as #popup-newsletter. Change it to show the popup again to visitors who closed it.
popup.blocking_info: No close button and no closing with Escape: add a Close button block. For age verification.
popup.dismiss: Never show the popup again after this click

trustpilot.widget_info: Copy the IDs from Trustpilot Business, in Integrations > TrustBox. The stars above show until the widget loads, once it is on screen.

facets.name: Filters
facets.open_groups: Groups open when the page loads
facets.open_groups_info: In the sidebar and the drawer. 0 keeps them closed.
facets.button_filters_info: Filter names separated by commas, for example Size, Waist. Suits sizes.

facets_button.name: Filter button
facets_button.info: Opens the filters of the section in a drawer. Hidden when there is nothing to filter, and on desktop when the filters already show in a sidebar or a bar.

grid_density.name: Grid density
grid_density.info: Shoppers switch between larger and smaller products. The choice is remembered on their device.

product_grid.name: Product grid
product_grid.pagination_info: Infinite scroll loads four pages as the shopper scrolls, then shows the button so the footer stays within reach.
product_grid.promo_row_info: On the first page, at this row of the grid.
product_grid.empty_info: Shown when there is nothing to list: an empty collection, or a search that finds nothing.
product_grid.info: Where the products appear. Products per page, columns and pagination are set on the section; promotion tiles and the content shown when nothing is found are set here. The card itself, image ratio included, is set on the Product Card block of this section.

bundle_builder.name: Bundle builder
bundle_builder.intro: Shoppers pick products one by one, then add them to the cart together. The theme shows the discount of each tier; Shopify charges it through an automatic discount you create in Discounts: Amount off products, with a minimum quantity of items, on the same products.
bundle_builder.bundle_name_info: Saved on every line as _story_bundle, hidden from shoppers, to recognise the bundle in your orders.
bundle_builder.mobile_bar_info: Shows the progress, the chosen items and the button while the products are on screen, and steps aside when the summary comes into view.

bundle_tier.name: Tier
bundle_tier.discount_info: Estimates the total shown in the summary. Empty label: the discount, for example 10% off.

card_parts.rating_info: A number out of 5, such as 4.8 (4,8 works too). Connect a metafield to show the rating of each item.
card_parts.widget_info: Each card loads its own widget once it nears the screen, and shows the stars above until then. On product cards, the product SKUs are sent for product reviews. Copy the IDs from Trustpilot Business, in Integrations > TrustBox.

product_info.accent_info: Icons, bar and highlights. Leave empty to follow the palette accent.

product_delivery.intro: Shows when the order ships and arrives, counted in working days from today in your store’s time zone.
product_delivery.shipping_info: Working days between shipping and delivery.

closed.label: Closed days
closed.info: Days when nothing ships or arrives, as DD/MM separated by commas, for example 25/12, 01/01.
